lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Has Ian sold his house yet?
lines.zh: 伊恩已把他的房子卖掉了吗？

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: Has he moved to his new house yet?

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.en: He has always been a good neighbour.

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.zh: 我们大家都会想念他的。

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: When will the new people move into this house?
lines.zh: 新住户什么时候搬进这所房子？

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.en: I think that they'll move in the day after tomorrow.
lines.zh: 我想他们将在后天搬进来吧。

lines.speaker: Linda
lines.en: Will you see Ian today, Jenny?
lines.zh: 詹尼，您今天会见到伊恩吗？

lines.speaker: Catherine
lines.en: He didn't want to leave this house.
lines.zh: 他本不想离开这幢房子。

lines.speaker: Jenny
lines.en: No, he didn't want to leave, but his wife did!
lines.zh: 是啊，他是不想离开，可是他妻子要离开。
